manual.transformers.line2: {0}§lTransformers§r are laminated iron cores wrapped in coils of wire that convert between different voltages of wire.{1}
manual.transformers.line3: Standard transformers can convert between LV and MV freely, but specialty circuits found in the HV Transformer are needed to convert to HV.{0}
manual.transformers.line4: Their compact internals allow standard transformers to be placed on {0}Posts{1}, however HV Transformers cannot be placed this way.{2}
manual.transformers.line5: The HV Transformer can step directly between LV and HV as necessary, thus reducing the number of transformers needed.{0}
